1. (Currently Amended) A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more __polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS) or 2-(cyclohexylamino)-ethanesulfonic acid (CHES)__[[CAPS-modified polyisocyanates]].

2. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two __different__ OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

3. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one __polyisocyanate modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS) or 2-(cyclohexylamino)-ethanesulfonic acid (CHES) and derived from__[[CAPS-modified polyisocyanate based on]] an aliphatic diisocyanate.

4. (Previously presented) The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

5. (Previously presented) A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

6. (Previously presented) A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.

7. (Currently Amended) The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm __as measured by contact angle measurement__.

8. (Currently Amended) The coating of claim 7, wherein the __root mean square__ surface roughness of the coating is greater than 200 nm __as measured by atomic force microscopy__.
